claim_scores.rationale: Defines custom `prefix` fields inside `warnings.catch_warnings`, records the warnings, and asserts the captured message contains the documented no-effect deprecation text.
Reads `PrefixedQA.input_fields[...]` and `output_fields[...]` metadata and asserts `json_schema_extra["prefix"]` exactly preserves both custom prefix strings.
Uses the default `dspy.ChatAdapter().format(...)` path and inspects both rendered messages via `messages[0]["content"]` and `messages[1]["content"]`.
Asserts both custom prefix strings are absent from both rendered prompt texts, matching the default chat rendering behavior.
Prints the warning messages, stored prefix metadata, and both rendered prompt texts so the stored-but-unused behavior is directly visible.
